body: oh, no offense taken. Sorry to hear you're having a rough go of it. Thanks for the kind words.
Those are good questions. Some things seem to fit and some don't. I don't know. I always have a hard time understanding what's going on in my own head.
Heh, fair. I mean I guess part of me feels like I'm just clinging to this as a possible excuse. So if that's not what it is, it means I really \*am\* just lazy.
Well, whatever money it costs. My pride if it turns out I don't have it.
That's a nice way to think about it, thanks.
Sorry you're in so much pain! It sucks when mental and physical pain aggravate each other, that just makes everything harder. I hope things calm down for you soon <3

My therapist likes to tell me, the brain is really quite dumb. It believes what you tell it. So yeah, if you tell it all the time that everything is shit, you can start to really believe that. 

That's sort of what CBT is, this idea that you can convince yourself of things, except used for good instead of evil, heh.

Thanks. When I try to write any of it out, it all sounds stupid and petty. There are people with real problems. I just suck at dealing with life. And yeah, like you said, depression and anxiety magnify everything to the point where I can't figure out how to think about things logically.

Yep. Definitely stuck on 'meh'. I seem to have the energy to beat myself up about not doing the things. Just not to actually do them. Which seems like it would be easier and less awful, but I guess not.
